propositions: The generic reads-under-contention property asserts shape validity but does not verify content completeness, allowing payloads with missing identity fields (ticket_id) to pass on all four surfaces (show, list, search, ready).

Seeded faults that emit zero-exit responses with structurally valid but content-hollow payloads (empty objects or records missing ticket_id) pass the existing shape-only check but fail the original regression test.
The property's intent requires that show returns an object with a truthy ticket_id, and list/search/ready return collections where every element carries a truthy ticket_id.

The fix adds per-surface content-completeness predicates to the SURFACES table and enforces them in _assert_complete_or_loud after the shape check, with valid-empty arrays treated as passing via vacuous truth of all() over empty collections.
The change is assertion-only with no new subprocess calls, fixture rounds, or subprocess invocations, preserving the property's wall-clock runtime.
